name: lucidheart-suite-manifest
description: Lockfile of canonical sovereign components, upstream forks, and external tools comprising the LucidHeart (HeartAwake) companion ecosystem.

heart.name: Heart Core
heart.description: Unique self-state machine, Mood 2.0 vector, life rhythm, evaluateActivity gates, and Protocol v1 validator.

fullawake.name: FullAwake
fullawake.description: PC sensory bridge, local desktop widget, and opt-in voice compute and singing.

qq-plus.name: QQ Plus
qq-plus.description: Dual-persona (Xiaoman/Axing) adaptive wake words, emotional typing cadence, and multi-bubble split.

rvc.name: RVC Voice
rvc.description: Feiyu voice synthesis, Heart mood mapping, QQ voice notes, PC ONNX CPU offload and phone fallback.

qqbot.name: DSH QQBot Sovereign Fork
qqbot.description: QQ Bot IM protocol driver with mediaSender auto-target resolution, active delivery fallback, and self-contained runtime.

mnemon.name: Mnemon Memory Suite
mnemon.description: Legacy Mnemon integration reference; not a claim of current activation or sole memory authority.

bili-scroll.name: Bili Scroll Sovereign Fork
bili-scroll.description: Bilibili duty, Heart gating, checkpointed co-viewing, and a text riddle.

video-storyboard.name: Video Storyboard Sovereign Fork
video-storyboard.description: Single-image 768px contact sheets and on-demand source cell inspection.

sticker-look.name: Sticker Look
sticker-look.description: Pure JS zero-dependency GIF frame decoder, contact sheet storyboard generator, and Heart Protocol v1 intent observer.

memory.name: LucidMemory
memory.description: Dedicated local-first memory core and DSH adapter; production activation and migration require separate evidence.

voice-duplex.name: Voice Duplex Sandbox
voice-duplex.description: Opt-in loopback audio sandbox with Silero ONNX, AEC, epoch interruption and latency capture.

vault.name: DSH-Vault
vault.role: Append-only encrypted disaster recovery backup system for mobile agent Xiaoman

remote-files.name: DSH-Remote-Files
remote-files.role: Read-only file browser for DSH and Android/Proot over USB/mTLS
